#393 · Penguin Pokémon

Piplup

Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Piplup is a Water-type Penguin Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5.2 kg. It evolves into Prinplup. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (61), with a base stat total of 314.
